main_body: wooden choir stall with high panelled backrest, canopy top, and cushioned bench
top_band: medium brown canopy roof (rows 8-12) with highlight at row 12; also cushioned seat surface at rows 37-40
evidence: The canopy top is a 5-row horizontal band (rows 8-12) with a clear front-edge highlight at row 12 and dark eave shadow at rows 13-14. The backrest panels (rows 16-35) are recessed with dark inner top/right edges. The seat surface (rows 37-40) shows 4 rows of horizontal plane (2 rows red cushion + 2 rows wood deck, with front edge highlight at row 40) above a 7-row front base (rows 41-47).

style.evidence: While the wood palette uses 6 brown steps and dark brown outlines, the five backrest panels (rows 16-35) are repetitive, untextured blocks with large 5x12 flat dark-brown fills inside the arches and uniform vertical bands, lacking the fine speckle, grain, and per-tile variation seen in the Beodeul stall and well references.
